News | September 01, 2026


## Northwest Bank Region Presidents Recognized Among Top Women Business Leaders


---


**Columbus, Ohio (August 31, 2026)** — Northwest Bank is proud to announce that its two region presidents, Kristen Hughes and Jennifer Gibson, have been recognized among the most influential women leaders in their respective regions for their outstanding leadership, business achievements and community impact.


Hughes, region president and executive director of retail banking, was named to Pennsylvania Business Central’s Women in Business’ Top Women CEOs & Leaders for 2026, a recognition honoring women who are making a significant impact through leadership, innovation and business excellence. The annual list celebrates accomplished executives who are driving growth within their organizations, shaping their industries and making meaningful contributions to their communities.


Gibson, region president and executive director of retail banking, was named to Buffalo Business First’s Power 200 Women list and Power 250. Both lists recognize influential leaders who are helping shape the future of Western New York through professional achievement, community engagement and organizational impact.


“These recognitions reflect the caliber of leadership we have across Northwest,” said Urich Bowers, chief consumer banking and strategy officer. “Kristen and Jennifer are both deeply committed to our customers, our associates and the communities we serve. Their ability to build strong relationships, lead with purpose and drive meaningful results exemplifies Northwest’s values and mission.”


Since joining Northwest in 2021, Hughes has played a key role in strengthening the bank’s presence across Pennsylvania and advancing strategic growth initiatives. She currently leads business development, community relations and customer experience efforts throughout the commonwealth, helping customers achieve their financial goals through personalized service and innovative solutions.


With more than two decades at Northwest, Gibson has held leadership positions across New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio and Indiana. She oversees consumer banking strategy, market development and multistate retail operations, while championing strategic growth, community partnerships and exceptional customer experiences.


“I’m honored to be recognized alongside so many inspiring women leaders,” said Hughes. “This recognition reflects the dedication of our associates across Northwest and the strong relationships we’ve built with our customers and communities.”


“It’s a privilege to be included among such accomplished women leaders,” said Gibson. “I’m proud of the work our Northwest team does every day to support our customers, strengthen relationships and make a positive difference in the communities we serve.”


Through their leadership, both women have helped advance Northwest’s commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences, fostering associate development and strengthening the neighborhoods the bank serves. Their recognitions underscore Northwest’s continued investment in leaders who drive growth while making a meaningful impact in the communities they call home.


### About Northwest Bancshares, Inc.


Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Northwest Bancshares, Inc. is the bank holding company of Northwest Bank. Founded in 1896, Northwest Bank is a full-service financial institution offering a complete range of business and personal banking products, as well as employee benefits and wealth management services. Northwest operates 152 full-service financial centers and 11 drive-up locations across Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio and Indiana, and provides customers with fee-free access to more than 55,000 ATMs. Northwest Bancshares, Inc.'s common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market (NWBI).
